# Programs 1 US program: the 2028 Investment Banking Summer Analyst Program in New York


*Last updated: November 2026*


Ardea Partners' summer 2028 internship is open now, and it has a hard deadline. The firm published its 2028 New York summer analyst posting on[its job board](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ardea-partners/4d9a30ba-a359-4062-a5ae-80d51311d959) on October 2, 2026, and its[careers page](https://www.ardeapartners.com/careers) gives the cutoff: **December 1, 2026 at 5pm ET** . The posting says Ardea will review applications "on a non-rolling basis after the deadline." We confirmed it was live on November 1, 2026. In plain words: you apply in fall 2026 as a sophomore, you intern in summer 2028 after your junior year.


The summer 2027 cycle is closed. Its deadline was January 2, 2026. One more thing to know before you start: the application requires a one-minute video, so leave yourself time to record it.


---


## What Is an Ardea Partners Internship?


An Ardea Partners internship is a 10-week investment banking summer analyst program in New York for undergraduates who will graduate between December 2028 and July 2029. Ardea is an independent advisory firm started by former Goldman Sachs partners; it dates its inception to 2017 and says it has completed "over 210 transactions representing $335bn in transaction value" since then, more than $200 billion of it in financial institutions deals, according to its[transactions page](https://www.ardeapartners.com/transactions) . Its[about page](https://www.ardeapartners.com/about) describes "a deep concentration in financial services" and lists 110+ team members across New York and London. Recent deals include The Baldwin Group's go-private transaction and At-Bay's sale to Munich Re. The posting says interns join "lean deal teams" and "take active roles on live transactions and client interactions," helping with financial modeling, research and client materials. The firm doesn't publish class size or a return-offer rate.


## When Do Ardea Partners Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


Ardea's own careers page, read through Wayback Machine captures, gives three cycles of dates. Summer 2026 applications closed January 10, 2025; the listing wasn't on the page in mid-October 2024 and was there by late December. Summer 2027 applications closed January 2, 2026; the recruiting tracker Trackr dates that opening to December 10, 2025, a third-party date. Summer 2028 opened on October 2, 2026, according to Ardea's job board, and closes December 1, 2026, about 20 months before a late-May 2028 start. Both dates moved earlier each year. The window also got longer. Because the dates keep shifting, any forecast is low-confidence: we expect summer 2029 applications in fall 2027, possibly earlier. Ardea's London office runs separate programs on a different calendar; this page covers New York.

*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


Ardea's posting gives you a fixed date, and the date is the whole story. **Applications close December 1, 2026 at 5pm ET, and the firm reviews them "on a non-rolling basis after the deadline."** Nothing submitted after the cutoff is considered, and applying early doesn't move you up the queue, so the goal is a complete, careful application before the deadline. Two things make that harder than it sounds, and the first is the video. The form wants one minute on "a problem you noticed before anyone asked you to solve it," which takes a few tries to get right. Second, if you found the role on Handshake, that listing shows an earlier apply-by date of November 5, 2026. Ardea's own posting says December 1. Submitting before November 5 removes any doubt. For summer 2029, watch the careers page from late summer 2027 rather than relying on this year's date.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


The rules come from the posting and the application form:


• **Class year:** you "must be enrolled in an undergraduate program and have an anticipated graduation date between December 2028 and July 2029." For most students that means current sophomores.


• **GPA:** no floor is stated, but the form requires your cumulative GPA. SAT and ACT scores are optional fields.


• **Work authorization:** the form asks whether you're authorized to work in the US and whether you need sponsorship now or in the future. The Handshake listing says "US work authorization required."


• **Major:** the form asks for it, but none is required.


• **Materials:** a resume and a one-minute video, plus education and work-history questions.


• **Securities registration:** the form asks whether you've ever been a registered representative in the securities industry.


### Does Ardea Partners Have a GPA Cutoff?


Not a published one. The GPA field is required, which tells you it's read, but Ardea doesn't say what number it screens on. International students should note the Handshake listing's work-authorization line and ask the recruiter before applying.

## What Skills Does Ardea Partners Look For, and How Do You Build Them?


Ardea's posting has no qualifications list, so this section draws on the posting, the careers page and candidate interview reports (community-reported on Wall Street Oasis). **Modeling and valuation:** interns assist with "financial modeling, research, and development of impactful client materials," and candidates report questions on WACC, DCF and beta, plus a paper LBO. **Financial services knowledge:** the firm concentrates on financial services, and one January 2026 candidate was asked how insurance firms make money. **Deal judgment and presenting:** two candidates describe a case study on a past Ardea deal, one of them building a slide. The careers page adds four qualities it wants: curiosity, diligence, entrepreneurship and client focus.

## What Is the Ardea Partners Application and Interview Process Like?


Ardea doesn't publish its interview process. The steps below combine the application form with candidate reports from Wall Street Oasis, which are community-reported.


1. **Apply on Ardea's job board by December 1, 2026, 5pm ET.** Upload a resume, enter your GPA and answer the work authorization questions.


2. **Record the one-minute video.** The form asks for about 20 seconds of introduction, then a story about a problem you noticed before anyone asked you to solve it: what you did, why, and the result.


3. **First round.** Reports describe a one-on-one interview with technical questions such as WACC, DCF and beta.


4. **Case study.** Two candidates describe analyzing a past Ardea deal; one built a slide on it.


5. **Superday.** One candidate reported five interviews, with questions on how insurers make money and a paper LBO. Another said the whole process ran over about three weeks in January 2026.


Our[superday interview guide](https://www.extern.com/post/superday-interview-guide) covers how to prepare for back-to-back final rounds.

## How Do You Stand Out for an Ardea Partners Internship?


Three moves. **First, treat the video as part of the interview.** Ardea asks for a story about a problem you noticed before anyone asked you to solve it. Pick a real one, say what you did and what changed, and keep the introduction to about 20 seconds as the form suggests. **Second, learn financial services deals.** Ardea says more than $200 billion of its deal value is in financial institutions, and candidates report insurance questions. Know how an insurer, a wealth manager and an asset manager each make money, and what a buyer pays for in each. **Third, prepare a view on two or three recent Ardea deals.** Candidates describe a case study on a past deal, and the[transactions page](https://www.ardeapartners.com/transactions) lists them with dates. In 2023 and 2024, Ardea's careers page listed three US summer openings; the current page says only "a small number," so expect a small class. No applicant count or conversion rate is published.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2027 Ardea Partners internship?


No. Ardea's summer 2027 New York program closed on January 2, 2026, and only the summer 2028 role is posted now. Juniors who missed it can ask the firm's recruiters or their career office about other openings. Sophomores graduating between December 2028 and July 2029 can apply for summer 2028 until December 1, 2026.


### When do Ardea Partners internship applications open for summer 2028?


They're open now. Ardea published its summer 2028 New York posting on October 2, 2026, about 20 months before the internship starts, and it closes December 1, 2026 at 5pm ET. The opening has moved earlier each year, so summer 2029 applications are expected in fall 2027, possibly earlier.


### Is the Ardea Partners internship rolling?


No. The posting says applications are collected through December 1, 2026 and reviewed "on a non-rolling basis after the deadline (5pm ET 12/1/26)." Applying early won't move you ahead, but nothing after the cutoff is considered. If you applied through Handshake, note that listing shows an earlier November 5 date.


### How much do Ardea Partners summer analysts make?


Ardea's Handshake listing for the summer 2028 program shows $100,000 to $120,000 a year, an annualized rate rather than what you'd earn over 10 weeks. The posting on Ardea's own job board doesn't show pay. Confirm the figure with the recruiter if you reach the offer stage.


### Who is eligible for the Ardea Partners internship?


Undergraduates with an expected graduation date between December 2028 and July 2029, which usually means current sophomores. No major or GPA floor is published, but the form requires your cumulative GPA. The Handshake listing says US work authorization is required, and the form asks about visa sponsorship.


### What does the Ardea Partners application ask for?


A resume, your school, major, degree and cumulative GPA, work history, work authorization answers and a required one-minute video. In the video you introduce yourself in about 20 seconds, then describe a problem you noticed before anyone asked you to solve it, what you did and the result.


### What are Ardea Partners interviews like?


Candidates on Wall Street Oasis describe a one-on-one first round, a case study on a past Ardea deal, then a superday; one reported five interviews. Questions included WACC, DCF, beta, how insurers make money and a paper LBO. For summer 2027 the process ran in January 2026. These accounts are community-reported.


### Do Ardea Partners interns get full-time offers?


Some do. Ardea's careers page says "High performing interns in New York City and London may be considered for a full-time position," and its team page includes an analyst who interned there in 2024 and joined full time in 2025. The firm doesn't publish a conversion rate, so treat any figure you see elsewhere as a guess.


Ardea's summer 2028 posting closes December 1, 2026 at 5pm ET and won't be read until after that date. Submit a finished application, video included, and walk into the case study with real work behind you: a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) gives you a modeling or valuation project to talk through.
